decisions.reconsider_when: Calibrated evidence supports another explicitly defined attribution state.

decisions.title: Runtime replacement and storage
decisions.choice: Installations use installed, archived, orphaned_runtime and missing states. Archival removes execution references while retaining hashes, notices and parameter descriptions. Adapter removal changes affected installations to orphaned_runtime and deletes no assets automatically. Users can archive them or clear unused caches.
decisions.rationale: Historical attribution should remain readable without requiring every executable model to remain installed forever.

alternatives.option: Retain weights for every historical reference
alternatives.tradeoff: Preserves easy replay but grows storage with every model tried.

alternatives.option: Delete assets when an adapter disappears
alternatives.tradeoff: Reclaims space but removes user data during an application update.

decisions.consequences: Generic stored parameter schemas keep old History readable. The manager reports unique and shared bytes, staging and runtime caches, and estimates archival effects. Restoring execution requires matching assets and a compatible adapter. I3 prevents archival from deleting active shared use.
decisions.reconsider_when: Users need an explicit automatic archival policy.

decisions.title: Context retention
decisions.choice: Persist context source status, timestamp and digest by default. Opt-in retention stores the exact bounded representation supplied to processing as an owned artifact, durably written before its reference. Exclude it from search. Delete it with its owner or through explicit context retention.
decisions.rationale: A digest identifies a sample but cannot replay its bytes. Retained context needs the same ownership discipline as audio.

alternatives.tradeoff: Improves replay availability while accumulating unrelated application content.
Simplifies storage but prevents deliberate replay with the original sample.

decisions.consequences: Absent context requires a visible omit-or-resample choice for reprocessing. Resampling creates a new manifest. Logs contain status and hashes without context payloads.
decisions.reconsider_when: A broader at-rest protection requirement applies to the library.

decisions.title: Materialization ownership
decisions.choice: Key materialization by setHash, service kind, runtime revision and cache-format revision. Register a unique temporary path under a creator lease. Copy from passed handles, verify every hash, synchronize files and completion manifest, then publish without replacement under a per-key claim. Verify and reference an existing destination. Commit asset registration before releasing the creator.
decisions.rationale: Shared content needs shared retention, while runtime-specific caches may differ across revisions.

alternatives.tradeoff: Simplifies lifetime but repeatedly copies large model sets.
Reduces Store work while losing deletion coordination and complete accounting.

decisions.consequences: I3 retains blobs and caches for qualifying installation references or active use. Archiving one installation cannot remove another's shared asset. Reconciliation covers dead creators, incomplete copies and orphan notices. Estimates count physical copies without assuming filesystem cloning.
decisions.reconsider_when: Verified descriptor loading or cloning reduces copies while preserving ownership.

decisions.title: Compatible local imports
decisions.choice: Identify models through a canonical manifest of weights, tokenizer, templates, feature configuration and required companions. Publisher labels, notices and benchmarks may be unknown. Compatibility validates structure, loading and result contracts. Empty recognition, empty diarization and immediate generation end-of-sequence are valid contract-shaped outcomes.
decisions.rationale: A user-built compatible model should not require invented metadata or a quality score.

alternatives.tradeoff: Simplifies supported-model claims but excludes compatible local assets.
Detects some poor models while misclassifying valid output as incompatibility.

decisions.consequences: The manager supports local import and mode selection with unmeasured quality labeled. D-027 separately controls resource admission. Download offerings need exact asset and notice inventories. The supplied SpeakerKit notices do not establish redistribution terms for every component.
decisions.reconsider_when: Another model family requires additional structural checks.

decisions.title: Long-input working memory
decisions.choice: Adapters declare finite buffers and ceilings in controlled window size, context length and concurrency. Decode reads incrementally. Speech and diarization receive bounded windows. Generation uses bounded context and output batches. Faithful rewrites process source spans, using overlap only as context and emitting each owned span once. Notes stage cited per-window items and reduce them through bounded fan-in passes. UI and Store page output.
decisions.rationale: Transport credit cannot prevent hidden whole-input accumulation inside a runtime.

alternatives.tradeoff: Bounds allocation by refusing long work and conflicts with the specification.
Avoids investigation but leaves internal accumulation unexamined.

decisions.consequences: Disk output and processing time may grow with duration. Boundary fidelity needs evaluation. Verification uses a finite statistical protocol, fixed ceilings and inspection under I7. A breach retains committed inputs and names the failed adapter.
decisions.reconsider_when: A runtime exposes a stronger bounded incremental contract or boundary errors require another strategy.

decisions.title: Diarization checkpoint ownership
decisions.choice: DiarizationService analyzes one window and returns its local output through D-003. The app's DiarizationCoordinator validates the current epoch, copies output into session-owned staging for the run, applies D-023's clipping and scans prior durable centroids using a 256-entry cache with paged disk access. It computes proposals and writes a window payload containing output, centroid references, overlap summaries and proposals. Synchronize payloads before appending a checksum-protected checkpoint containing input hash, window index, parameters, runtime revision and artifact lengths. Only then acknowledge service output.
decisions.rationale: The app must own resumable evidence before disposable service scratch can be reclaimed. Cross-window candidate scanning needs no model inference and can use bounded app-side vector operations.

alternatives.option: Keep checkpoints only in service scratch
alternatives.tradeoff: Avoids copying but couples resume to an execution epoch that cleanup may remove.
Simplifies progress while exposing incomplete analysis.

decisions.consequences: Recovery accepts the checkpoint prefix and discards unfinished tails. A resumed epoch receives the next audio window and pinned model configuration. The coordinator reads prior centroids from app staging, so none must survive in service scratch. Cache eviction never removes evidence or forces identity matches. New clusters always get IDs. Completed output enters hidden database preparation under D-005, followed by one short I2 publication transaction. Cancellation removes staging after leases drain. Service cleanup cannot remove durable checkpoints.
decisions.reconsider_when: A tested incremental diarizer supplies persistent state with lower analysis or linking cost.

coverage.explanation: Ordered application and website predicates resolve conflicts, missing context falls through, and the visible selected mode is frozen for the run.
Each built-in specifies permitted transformations and question preservation, with named checks and explicit limits on semantic evidence.
Application text, screen context and clipboard data have sampling deadlines, instruction separation, owned retention and permission behavior.
Users control prompts, formatting and local model selections. Snapshots preserve the meaning of active work and saved output.
Menu bar access, microphone gain and player controls are defined. Restoration requires continuing ownership, with explicit resumption for unsupported integrations.
Search, playback and reprocessing use immutable result chains. Deletion invalidates publication and retention observes live ownership.
Microphone, system audio and the audio/video format matrix share bounded ingest. Decoder extensions remain local and failed imports preserve external sources.
Explicit selection, detection fallback and English translation have defined compatibility behavior. Recognition and derived language quality are evaluated separately.
Local speaker analysis has explicit window ownership, durable checkpoints and uncertain proposals. Editable revisions support timestamped notes without changing saved results.
Acquisition, compatibility, identity and no-replace publication cover staged and installed models. Shared storage and runtime replacement remain accountable, without quality-score gates.
Global toggle and push-to-talk include per-mode bindings, submission intent, bounded startup and cancellation at every stage.
The movable panel retains placement and distinguishes provisional text from final output. Preview has standing capacity and failures remain visible.
One executor applies target policy, insertion and submission semantics. Uncertain paste has explicit review and recovery behavior. Permission loss holds output and offers Copy.
Prompt-term selection, replacements and filler removal have deterministic ordering and matching rules, with no guarantee of recognition accuracy.

open_questions.question: Do the selected pinned runtimes operate through the signed container-local arrangement?
open_questions.resolution: F2 evaluates the concrete D-003 choice before adapter acceptance. The mechanism is decided. Failure requires a compliant adapter change. If no adapter supports a required operation, that integration becomes blocking.

open_questions.question: Which model configurations meet the quality and resource criteria on the evaluation Mac?
open_questions.resolution: F1 and F5 replace provisional envelopes and select defaults. The standing reservation and generation admission arithmetic are already decided in D-027.

open_questions.question: Can the complete stack provide acceptable behavior on Intel Macs?
open_questions.resolution: D-001 selects initial arm64 packaging. Intel investigation requires identified hardware, whisper.cpp and llama.cpp evaluation, and a compatible local diarizer before Intel support is advertised.

open_questions.question: Which targets can support unattended acknowledgment and modifier-requested submission?
open_questions.resolution: Inspect concrete integration semantics and establish the F4 support matrix. Generic targets already use D-009 and D-010's explicit confirmation path. Unattended submission cannot be claimed until a qualifying adapter exists, and successful trials alone cannot qualify one.

open_questions.question: Is the review cost of generic paste acceptable in repeated dictation?
open_questions.resolution: D-010 makes per-paste resolution the baseline where acknowledgment is absent. F4 measures actions and blocked time per target. An unacceptable result requires another supported delivery integration or an explicit behavior revision, without timers or automatic retries.

open_questions.question: Which real players expose ownership-preserving conditional resumption?
open_questions.resolution: Inspect documented integrations and test competing actions before enabling automatic resume. D-025 supplies player-specific manual resumption without assuming playback position establishes ownership.

open_questions.question: Which diarization assets may be offered as optional downloads?
open_questions.resolution: Compile exact component hashes and notices before catalog publication. Local model import and runtime integration remain available independently of redistribution permission.

open_questions.question: Can resource-growth equivalence be resolved within the finite repetition budget?
open_questions.resolution: Run the pilot and prespecified confirmation protocol in verification. An unresolved bound is inconclusive and blocks resource acceptance of that adapter until instrumentation or implementation improves. The growth margin is not relaxed merely to absorb noise.
